top_10_findings.title: VIX is the sufficient statistic for VT
top_10_findings.detail: 21+ confirmations across VIX term structure, VVIX, SKEW, credit spreads, yield curves, AAII, CNN Fear&Greed, Google Trends, CAPE, MOVE, macro, and more. No additional indicator adds value once VIX is included.
top_10_findings.impact: Simplifies the entire VT framework to a single variable

top_10_findings.title: VT Sharpe improvement NOT significant; MDD improvement IS
top_10_findings.detail: VT Sharpe t=0.33 (NS). MDD bootstrap p=0.0004 (highly significant). MDD improvement is mechanical (99% under null). VT value = risk management, not alpha generation.
top_10_findings.impact: Correctly frames VT as insurance, not alpha

top_10_findings.title: 50/50 SPY/GLD is the unbeatable retail portfolio
top_10_findings.detail: 8 independent validations. Sharpe 0.83, MDD -16%. Cannot be beaten by optimization, dynamic allocation, or adding assets. QQQ tail dep lambda_L=0.82; TLT structural break post-2022.

top_10_findings.title: Leverage direction taxonomy predicts VT mechanism
top_10_findings.detail: Gamma sign predicts VT behavior: trend follower (gamma>0, equities), contrarian (gamma<0, gold), pure variance mgmt (gamma~0, bonds). 17-asset Spearman rho=0.874 (p=4e-6). EGARCH cross-verified.

top_10_findings.title: QLIKE ceiling is universal across GARCH variants
top_10_findings.detail: 15+ confirmations. 31 models scored: 52% provide zero/negative value. 14 models x 3 assets: top 7 statistically indistinguishable. Only 5-min RV can potentially break it.

top_10_findings.title: Asia-Pacific Time-Zone Arbitrage is structural
top_10_findings.detail: 6/8 local markets pass Harvey (HK/AU/SG/KR/TW/JP). All US-listed ETF controls fail. 13-year rolling: NO decay. Alpha is structural (timezone gap) not statistical.
top_10_findings.impact: Actionable trading strategy for Asia-Pacific investors

top_10_findings.title: Diversification amplifies leverage effect
top_10_findings.detail: SPY gamma 2.8x individual stock gamma (50-stock, t=-16.92). Taiwan 4.6x. Japan 0.7x (attenuation). Mechanism: correlation asymmetry.
top_10_findings.impact: Novel finding for Paper 1; explains ETF vs stock VT

top_10_findings.title: VT insurance pricing: ~1-4%/yr, MDD protection 8/8 decades
top_10_findings.detail: 76-year analysis: mean ~1%/yr (not 4%/yr). VIX era 2-4%/yr, std=2.54%. K36/K39/K40 trilogy: 'insurance compounds' not 'VT hurts long-term'.

top_10_findings.title: Skewed Student-t is the best VaR distribution (6/6 Kupiec)
top_10_findings.detail: Only method passing all 6 assets. CF-VaR 5/6 (QQQ over-conservative). Master VaR Panel T21: 7x5x3x3=315 cells tested. MLE auto-adapts df+skewness per asset.

top_10_findings.title: GJR-GARCH is MCS superior for equity volatility
top_10_findings.detail: MCS p=0.044 excludes symmetric GARCH. Advantage proportional to skewness (equities only; breaks for BTC). w=2000 recommended. Multi-step advantage amplifies at longer horizons.
top_10_findings.impact: Core model selection for the research system

top_5_methodology_lessons.title: Same-day timing bias inflates VIX backtest Sharpe by ~1.0
top_5_methodology_lessons.detail: VIX_t for r_t: Sharpe 1.98. VIX_t for r_{t+1}: Sharpe 0.81. Mechanism: corr(VIX, SPY)=-0.65. All VIX studies must use lagged weights.

top_5_methodology_lessons.title: Single-period OOS is unreliable; need 5+ cross-OOS periods
top_5_methodology_lessons.detail: J9: EWMA beats GARCH in 2023-24 but GARCH wins crisis. T22 GBM ceiling break: 0/15 cross-asset cells significant. |Skewness| N=12 rho=-0.87 collapsed to N=21 rho=-0.086.

top_5_methodology_lessons.title: Measurement tautology: proxy choice determines conclusion
top_5_methodology_lessons.detail: Rolling Parkinson predicting Parkinson = self-referential (G28). Forward r^2 target: GARCH wins 7/7 assets. Evaluation target matters more than model choice.

top_5_methodology_lessons.title: Small cross-sectional samples produce inflated correlations
top_5_methodology_lessons.detail: |Skewness|: N=12 rho=-0.87 -> N=21 rho=-0.086. Gamma-mechanism: N=7 rho=1.000 -> N=12(all) rho=-0.448 (NS). Rule: N>=15 for cross-sectional claims.

top_5_methodology_lessons.title: TZ momentum c2c Sharpe includes uncapturable overnight gap
top_5_methodology_lessons.detail: c2c Sharpe 3.09 but o2o only 0.87 (-72%). 78% of alpha in gap (R^2=0.35). Requires position before signal exists.
